resource: Parameter OIDs announced by one PostgreSQL ParameterDescription on the first-slice production root profile
allocation_impact: Validate peer count <=32 and exact body size 2 + 4*count before SmallVec::with_capacity or parameter metadata retention.
boundary_tests: 32 parameters accepted when the complete body and built-in-only OID policy pass
33 parameters rejected as UNAVAILABLE before SmallVec allocation
Truncated, overlong or checked-arithmetic-invalid bodies rejected before retained parameter metadata
notes: Current composed WP3/WP4 SQL uses no more than 15 positional bind parameters; 32 is the owner-selected finite first-slice compatibility ceiling, not the PostgreSQL u16 protocol maximum.
